recognize_zh: 骨髓切片幾乎完全被脂肪細胞取代，僅剩小血管、零星淋巴球/漿細胞與含棕色含鐵血黃素（hemosiderin）色素的巨噬細胞，看不到任何造血島或巨核細胞，符合再生不良性貧血。
features: Marrow space almost entirely replaced by adipocytes (profound hypocellularity)
Absence of recognizable erythroid islands, granulocytic precursors or megakaryocytes
Scattered residual small lymphocytes, plasma cells and stromal/endothelial cells
Macrophages containing coarse golden-brown cytoplasmic pigment (likely hemosiderin)
Small thick-walled arterioles and capillaries; no fibrosis, granulomas or abnormal infiltrate
describe_en: High-power view of a hematoxylin and eosin-stained bone marrow biopsy shows marrow space almost completely occupied by adipocytes. Residual cells are limited to scattered lymphocytes, plasma cells, endothelial cells and macrophages containing brown pigment, consistent with hemosiderin. No erythroid or granulocytic precursors, megakaryocytes, fibrosis, granulomas or abnormal infiltrate are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with severe marrow hypoplasia, in keeping with aplastic anemia in the appropriate clinical and peripheral blood context.

ddx.vs: Hypoplastic MDS retains clusters of dysplastic megakaryocytes or abnormally localized immature precursors, sometimes with reticulin fibrosis, and may show clonal cytogenetic abnormalities.
Serous atrophy shows pale pink-blue extracellular gelatinous material between shrunken fat cells, which is absent here.

ddx.dx: Hypocellular (hypoplastic) acute leukemia or hairy cell leukemia
ddx.vs: Residual cells would include clusters of blasts (CD34+) or hairy cells (CD20+, annexin A1+) rather than only lymphocytes, plasma cells and macrophages.
Clinical history of cytotoxic therapy or a biopsy composed mainly of subcortical marrow must be excluded; true aplastic anemia is diffusely hypocellular throughout an adequate core.
